title: Add GitHub Actions workflow: cargo build and test on PR
description:
Create .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs on every PR and push to main. Steps: checkout, install stable Rust toolchain, `cargo build --workspace`, `cargo test --workspace`. Must complete in under 10 minutes. Artifact: .github/workflows/ci.yml.

Acceptance: workflow runs on PR; red on test failure; green on pass; no hardcoded toolchain version (uses rust-toolchain.toml)
